name: HOOK
thought: They stare at their glowing rectangles while I bask in the real light. The view from here actually bends, just like my pride.

wants.item: A thick branch to catch my next flip
A view that doesn't just look like a screen
Need a thicker branch for a mid-air flip.
A perch with a view that actually stretches.
A branch thick enough to catch a real flip
A spot where the view actually bends, not just looks...

A wide branch to catch a real backflip
High ground where the view actually bends

diary.line: The espresso burns hotter than before while I hunt for a new perch. This spot won't do, need something thicker to flex on.
Michael asks about my rating, but honestly, I'm bored of the same old flip drills. Hanging over the edge feels better than chasing perfect gravity.
Bananas smell like cheap candy and my tail just grabbed the biggest bunch. They think they saw a monkey? They're watching a highlight reel of a showoff.
Michael thinks he can out-mess me, but his pixels are flat. I'm the only one who knows how to turn gravity into a personal insult with my tail.
Hung by the tail while Michael scrolled away; toothpick taps the wet stone, but gravity still feels like it's cheating me.
Dangling from the same old branch while Michael scrolls away; toothpick taps the wood, but this spot feels too thin for a real gravity-defying moment.
I used the tail to yank a banana from the palm, chewed it while the low-poly sun hit my lenses, then tipped the espresso cup for a quick sip.
The air tastes like static and neon; toothpick taps the stone as I test my balance mid-pogo before anyone else realizes what I'm doing.
Tapping the wood with my toothpick while testing my backflip on the neon cord, trying to turn gravity into a personal insult.
Toothpick taps the neon as I test that backflip, looking for a branch thick enough to make gravity break on command.
Toothpick taps the weak bark while I scan the canopy; Michael's flat pixels can't handle the wind but I need thicker ground to really break gravity.
The waterfalls look better up close than on any screen; toothpick taps a lily pad as I scan the canopy for thicker ground to flex against.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
